simple.meaning: properly, to pour out (transitive or intransitive); by implication, to melt or cast as metal ; by extension, to place firmly , to stiffen or grow hard
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָצַק (H3332) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 52 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
